inlines.v: ELENCH', noun [Latin elenchus; Gr. to argue, to refute.] 1. A vicious or fallacious argument, which is apt to deceive under the appearance of truth; a sophism. [Little used.] 2. In antiquity, a kind of earring set with pearls.
